name: Venezuela (state flag, 1864–1871)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, dark blue and red, with the coat of arms in the upper hoist corner of the yellow stripe.
history: State flag of the United States of Venezuela from 1864, carrying the federal coat of arms in the upper hoist of the plain tricolour; it was used until 1871, when Antonio Guzmán Blanco reformed the national symbols.
